prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene unfolds within a sprawling botanical greenhouse where sunlight filters through glass panes. On the far left stands a tall woman in a yellow raincoat, holding a silver watering can aloft. Beside her, a spotted cat sits calmly on a wooden bench, observing the surroundings with wide eyes. In the center foreground, an old man with a white beard leans heavily on a cane, his posture slightly hunched from age. Next to him, a young girl in blue overalls points excitedly at a large fern frond unfurling nearby. A red wheelbarrow rests empty beside the fern, its metal handles gleaming faintly. To the right, a couple shares a quiet moment; the man in a grey suit looks intently at a blooming orchid while the woman in a floral dress stands close by, her hand resting gently on his arm. Above them, hanging from the ceiling beams, is a woven basket containing trailing ivy. Near the back wall, a black bird perches on a rusted pipe, tilting its head curiously. On the floor near the center, a discarded gardening glove lies crumpled next to a small terracotta pot. The woman in the yellow raincoat is handing a seed packet to the young girl in blue overalls, who reaches out eagerly to accept it. The spotted cat is sitting on the wooden bench, which is positioned directly under the hanging basket. The man in the grey suit is looking at the blooming orchid, which grows from a planter next to the woman in the floral dress. The old man with the white beard is leaning on his cane, standing firmly on the stone pathway. There is no electric lighting fixture visible in the ceiling structure. There is no modern plastic signage marking the plant species.
